title: 우편환법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:27:0:00031:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 27 (Request for Suspension of Payment)
(1) The payer or the recipient may request the suspension of payment. In this case, when specifying the period for suspension, the period must be indicated in the suspension of payment request. <Amended July 8, 2016>
(2) Any person wishing to make a request for suspension of payment in accordance with paragraph (1) must demonstrate that they have the authority to make such a request.
(3) Any person making a request in accordance with paragraph (1) must pay the fee as determined and announced by the Minister of Science, ICT and Future Affairs. <Amended July 31, 1998, March 3, 2008, March 24, 2013, July 26, 2017>
